messages:
Ava: Morning — quick logistics: a courier just dropped off a backpack at the lobby for Raj but there was no signature. Courier said 'left with reception'. Also we have a guest coming at 10:15 for a product demo who needs a day badge + accessible seating. Can someone confirm badge prereg and if the backpack is okay to hold at front desk?
Front Desk Bot: @Ava  Note: items left by courier without signature are logged as 'UNCLAIMED - COURIER' and held at front desk for 48 hrs. Please include recipient name in the pickup request. Guest prereg link: https://redwood-internal/checkin. Accessible seating noted.
Facilities: @Ava we have one accessible desk in Hotdesk Row A and the small conference table by the kitchen is cleared for 10:000:30. Need a ramp? The building entrance ramp is on the eastside and is accessible.
Raj: That backpack is probably mine  I ordered a charger kit. Im remote until noon; can someone sign it out for me if they check ID? Otherwise Ill pick it up at 12:10.
Tessa: I can grab it and sign out for Raj at 11:50 if needed. @Front Desk Bot what's the sign-out process for personal items?
Front Desk Bot: Sign-out process: recipient or authorized designee shows ID, signs pickup form. Authorized designee must be named in the pickup request DM to Mailroom.
Ava: I'll DM Mailroom to authorize Tessa. Also small ask  can we get a one-off table sign that says 'Reserved  Demo guest until 11:00' so folks don't clear plates?
Facilities: We'll drop a laminated sign at the demo table by 9:45. Also leaving an extra trash bin nearby.
Raj: Thanks team. If the backpack isn't claimed by 48 hrs it goes to Lost & Found per policy, right?
Front Desk Bot: Correct. Items unclaimed after 48 business hours are moved to Lost & Found and logged. Policy: perishable or fragile items may have different handling; notify Mailroom if special care needed.
Tessa: DM sent authorizing pickup for Raj. Ill bring ID and the pickup form.
Ava: Great. One minor FYI  the guest might bring a small camera bag and asked if they can leave it at the desk during the demo. Front Desk Bot, ok to store small camera bags?
Front Desk Bot: Small personal items ok for temporary storage during meetings (max 4 hours). For longer holds, please prereg through Mailroom. Note: front desk holds items for 3 business days by default.
Ava: Perfect. Thanks everyone  Ill update the calendar invite with 'meet at lobby, host: Ava' and close this thread once Tessa confirms pickup. :thumbsup:
Tessa: Picked up Raj's backpack at 11:50. Left a note on the mail log. Demo guest checked in at 10:12, seated in Hotdesk Row A. All good. :white_check_mark:
